{{recipesummary|category=Soup recipes|servings=6|time=1 hour|difficulty=2}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==

* 2 cans (28 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) fat-free vegetable [[Cookbook:Broth|broth]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 bag (1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) frozen [[Cookbook:Mixed vegetables|mixed vegetables]]
* 1 can (14½ ounces) no-salt-added [[Cookbook:Stew|stewed]] [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* ⅓ cup broken [[cookbook:Pasta|angel-hair pasta]], in 1- to 2-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] lengths
* 1 can (15 ounces) no-salt-added [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]]
* 1 can (15 ounces) no-salt-added [[Cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic powder]]
* ¼ cup grated [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]

==Procedure==

# Pour broth and water into a 4½-[[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]] or soup pot.
# Place pot over high heat.
# While liquid is heating, add frozen vegetables, stewed tomatoes with their juices and uncooked pasta.
# Cover pot and bring to [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]].
# Meanwhile, rinse and drain beans.
# When soup comes to a boil, uncover it and stir well. Scrape the pot with a [[Cookbook:Wooden Spoon|wooden spoon]] to loosen any pasta.
# Add beans, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder.
# Reduce heat to medium-high or medium, maintaining a moderate boil.
# Stir frequently and cook until pasta is tender, about 5 minutes.
# Reduce heat to low and add Parmesan.
# Stir occasionally and simmer for 5 minutes to develop the flavor.
# Serve at once or simmer on low until ready to serve.
